no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

{
  "headline": "STRENGTH trial of Epanova (omega-3 carboxylic acids) stopped early for futility with no cardiovascular benefit demonstrated in statin-treated patients with mixed dyslipidaemia.",
  "summary": "The STRENGTH trial randomized approximately 13,086 statin-treated patients with hypertriglyceridaemia (TG 175–499 mg/dL) and low HDL-C to Epanova 4 g daily or corn oil placebo, targeting 1,600 primary endpoint events over a planned 3-year median follow-up. The independent data monitoring committee recommended discontinuation because Epanova was unlikely to demonstrate a benefit. No placebo-adjusted triglyceride change was measured in the phase 3 population; phase 2 data showed only a within-arm reduction of −26%. The failure is attributed primarily to design choices — corn oil placebo (which may raise LDL-C and increase control-arm events), a broad MACE composite including softer endpoints (revascularization, unstable angina), and early stopping before the planned event count — and to uncertainty about whether triglyceride lowering via this EPA+DHA formulation is causally linked to cardiovascular risk reduction. Confidence in this assessment is medium.",
